title: BattleAxes & Stuff
description: Here resides BattleAxes and other related projects to MTNS.
body:
## Embark on an adventure to the Moon and discover brand-new biomes, blocks, items, and more!

### **1. New Ores!** 
> - Nether, 
> - End
> - and Real-Life/Custom variants!

### **2. New biomes!**
> - Classic biomes

### **3. A bunch of new blocks!**
> - New wood types!
> - Moon blocks
> - And bunch more!

### **4. Brand new items + tools!**
> - Vanilla-like
> - And even custom ones!

### **5. Brand new dimensions!**
> - The Moon and its various features!



**_The mod and datapack have been made in MCreator. (Link: https://mcreator.net/)_**

***Also, there may be a slow update cycle between versions for the datapack - please be patient! / BattleAxes is now outdated!***
